card.name: Repeated digit in numbers
card.fires_on: A digit (or '-two') inside a number that repeats the digit just before it, such as the 2 in 2,200 or the 5 in 5,500. It also fires on '-two' after 'forty'.

modes.label: Repeated digit after comma
modes.description: The first digit after a thousands comma matches the leading digit.

modes.label: Repeated digit after decimal
modes.description: A digit after a decimal point or section number repeats the digit before it.

card.plain: It lights up on a number's digit that doubles the digit just before it, as in 2,200 or 5,500.
